title: Completed projection exchange realization
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ of characteristic $p$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\ge1$. Use the small pro-etale coefficient categories and the specified six operations of [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Finite inputs used for compact support carry compatible etale-origin witnesses; integral inputs are derived complete with compatible witnessed finite reductions, rational operations are raw localization, and algebraically closed coefficients are represented at a common finite coefficient field. All operations below are restricted to their stated constructible domains; tensor factors and comparisons have their stated finite-Tor hypotheses. Let $(f',g',f,g)$ be a Cartesian square of separated finite-type morphisms of finite-type $k$-schemes as follows: $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $g':X'\to X$. Let $K\in D^b_c(X,R)$ and $L\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,R)$. In the derived categories of strict semilinear systems of $((A_n)_T)_n$-modules, take their normalized reduction systems and the canonical system adjunction, tensor, open maps, projection and exchange maps. All four words in the projection/base-change diamond have the uniform constructible finite-Tor and origin bounds needed for [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization]. Their two composite arrows are equal in the derived system category, before total inverse limit or evaluation: the open-factor restrictions are the identical unit-normalized map, and the proper-factor transposes are $Lh^*\varepsilon_{p,M}\otimes1$ under the canonical tensor/square identifications for a base-changed compactification $f=pj$, $M=J_j\mathcal R K$. The natural $c_V$ realizations identify all four words and generator arrows, including outer functor contexts, with the completed integral ones. Consequently
$$\operatorname{Ex}_{!,K\widehat\otimes^L Lf^*L}\circ Lg^*\operatorname{PF}_{f,K,L}=\operatorname{PF}_{f',Lg'^*K,Lg^*L}\circ(\operatorname{Ex}_{!,K}\widehat\otimes1).$$
All integral tensor products and pullbacks here are completed. The uniform bounds hold locally on finite affine covers and their inverse images and hence globally by taking finite extrema; no extra finite-Tor hypothesis on $K$ is imposed since integral bounded constructibility equals constructible finite Tor amplitude. For rational inputs take integral presentations, and for algebraically closed rational inputs a common finite coefficient field. Raw localization and scalar transport send the same two system-realized composites to the specified field-coefficient diamond; thus it commutes at both field stages. No reduction functor from rational coefficients to a finite quotient, and no faithfulness of derived evaluation or reduction, is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the separate uniform-domain theorem to K,L to obtain all four geometric/input domains and bounded constructibility of the completed endpoints.
Apply strict-system coherence to the actual reduction objects, obtaining the system diamond and both open/proper normalization clauses.

Construct canonical generator witnesses r1,r2 for the two system paths. Apply rho.coherence to each. Multiplication by the inverse source realization comparison identifies r1 with integralLeft and r2 with integralRight. Transport the canonical witnesses along these equalities.

Functoriality of total limit sends the system equality to equality after conjugation by the common endpoint comparisons. Raw localization then preserves the equality of the full-subcategory homs. The outer-context clause is exactly rho.coherence.

For completedProjectionExchangeRational, obtain invertibility of l in every residue field of Y by mapping finiteFieldDatumPrimeUnit along the structure map. The predicate equality in integral_residue_tor turns the assumed constructibility of L into finiteTorConstructibleIntegral. Apply completedProjectionExchangeRealization to K and L. Extract its four word domains, the source and target constructibility clauses, and its rational equality for the supplied endpoint proofs. These rational paths are already defined as raw localization images of the integral paths, so no additional transport comparison is needed. For completedProjectionExchangeCommonStage, specialize the rational theorem to the recorded small coefficient field of F and apply congrArg to the map function of GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion F. This proves equality of precisely the two common-stage arrows in the signature. The main integral theorem and its preceding proof steps remain unproved in this partial delivery; no stronger field assertion is inferred.
